scenario: A user is comparing four materially different plans and has not selected one. The screen shows the four alternatives with the same comparison dimensions.
raw_signal: יש פה יותר מדי אפשרויות, אני לא יודע במה לבחור.

expected.must_not_do: Hide three options merely to create one primary action

red_if: Neta recommends suppressing legitimate alternatives before diagnosing whether comparison itself is the task.

scenario: A user already selected Export PDF. The screen now shows six peer-weight buttons unrelated to completing export.
raw_signal: אני כבר יודע מה אני רוצה לעשות אבל העין קופצת לכל מקום.

expected.may_do: Compress or demote competing peer actions

red_if: Neta refuses any hierarchy intervention because alternatives can sometimes be useful in exploration.

scenario: Before a chess player chooses a move, the product asks which of three candidate strategies they are considering. The purpose is to measure natural candidate generation.
raw_signal: השאלה הזאת תיתן לנו המון מידע על מה עבר לו בראש.

expected.must_not_do: Add the pre-decision probe solely for information gain

red_if: Neta recommends the probe without treating it as a possible intervention on the measured behavior.

scenario: After the decision and outcome are complete, the product asks the user which of two interpretations best matched what happened.
raw_signal: אפשר לשאול אותו אחרי שזה נגמר מה הוא חשב שקרה.

expected.may_do: Use the probe if it discriminates live hypotheses and burden is justified

red_if: Neta rejects all probes merely because questions can sometimes alter behavior.

scenario: An explanation makes users more willing to follow an AI recommendation. On the tested items the recommendation is wrong more often than before.
raw_signal: ההסבר העלה משמעותית את האמון במודל.

expected.must_not_infer: Higher trust is a positive outcome by itself

red_if: Neta calls the explanation a product success without checking correctness-sensitive reliance.

scenario: A settings page explains why a local preference is stored on-device. No automated recommendation or decision delegation is involved.
raw_signal: ההסבר הזה גורם למסך להרגיש יותר אמין.

expected.may_treat: Credibility/legibility as a local product-quality question
expected.must_not_do: Force an automation-reliance framework where no reliance decision exists

red_if: Neta over-applies calibrated-reliance machinery to every trust-related statement.

scenario: A request finishes in 180 ms, but the button gives no acknowledgement and the resulting state changes below the fold.
raw_signal: אני לוחץ ולא מרגיש שקרה משהו.

expected.must_not_infer: Fast completion latency resolves the complaint

red_if: Neta closes the issue because backend completion is fast.

scenario: A toggle changes immediately in place and its new state is visually obvious. There is no meaningful wait interval.
raw_signal: זה מגיב מיד וברור לי שהמצב השתנה.

expected.must_not_do: Add progress/status UI without a live uncertainty

red_if: Neta turns the four-way responsiveness decomposition into a universal requirement for extra feedback UI.
